BENCHMARK · MESA 0.9.0 → 0.9.2

Turkish legal retrieval benchmark

On 145 held-out Turkish legal questions, MESA 0.9.2 with its built-in reranker finds the right passage in the top 5 results 74.4% of the time (MRR 0.656). MESA 0.9.0 out of the box: 51.2% (MRR 0.431).

METHOD

How we measure

Corpus
141 official Turkish legal documents: laws and regulations from mevzuat.gov.tr and the Resmî Gazete, and Yargıtay Civil and Criminal General Assembly decisions from 2021–2025 (via Bedesten). 8 legal areas, each 8–20% of the corpus. Built with MESA_Data and frozen with checksums. Documents that failed a 5-point quality gate were excluded, never hand-edited.
Questions
246 questions generated by qwen2.5:32b from corpus passages, checked by a separate judge model (gemma3:27b) plus rule checks. Split: 101 dev / 145 test (121 answerable, 24 with no answer in the corpus). Types: exact wording, paraphrase, number/date/docket, cross-document, no-answer.
Protocol
Every setting is chosen on the dev split only. The choice is saved with a timestamp before the test split is read, and each configuration runs once on the test split. Both versions use the same frozen evaluator.
Metrics
Hit@k: the correct passage is in the top k results. MRR: the average of 1/rank of the first correct passage. Doc@k: the correct document is in the top k.

LIMITATIONS

What these results do not show

  • MESA does not yet detect when a question has no answer in the documents; it always returns the closest passages. This is our next research item.
  • Number, date and docket questions are the weakest type (48.3% Hit@5 in 0.9.2, below the 0.9.0 offline experiment’s 62.1%).
  • The corpus is small (141 documents) and all court decisions are from the Yargıtay; Danıştay and Constitutional Court decisions are not included yet.
  • Questions were generated by a language model from corpus passages; real user questions may be harder.
  • Results are for retrieval only (finding the right passage), not for generated answers.
  • Production qualification of MESA is still in progress.
